description: Partnered with legal department of multi-state client (40,000+ employees) to establish ADAAA and other workplace compliance. Identified and updated a backlog of LOA and accommodation issues.

matchmaking_summary: The candidate possesses a strong background in full range of HR functions, including employee management, hiring, training, and compliance with State and Federal laws. Their experience includes establishing HR infrastructure during companies' transition from small to mid-size, implementing performance management processes, managing leave matters like FMLA, CFRA, and ADAAA, and providing guidance on recruitment and retention efforts that contribute significantly to business success.
